Some of the fractions obtained from the fractional distillation of petroleum are used as fuels
for vehicles.
Which two fractions are used as fuels for vehicles?
A
bitumen fraction and gasoline fraction
B
bitumen fraction and naphtha fraction
C
gasoline fraction and kerosene fraction
D
kerosene fraction and lubricating fraction
subject: Chemistry
